searched: Searched 2026-10-29 for 2023–2026 founders, leaders, moves and funding rounds of Chinese frontier labs (Zhipu, MiniMax, Moonshot AI, Baichuan, 01.AI, StepFun, DeepSeek, ByteDance Seed, Alibaba Qwen/Tongyi, Tencent, Baidu, Xiaomi), after checking existing-claims.txt, existing-entities.txt (including Chinese aliases), people-pack-claims.txt and the capital records in data/claims.json (the c2 MiniMax investor records are not in existing-claims.txt). Primary sources retrieved and used: Zhipu’s English HKEX prospectus of 30 December 2025 (pre-IPO rounds B1–B6, investor descriptions, directors and senior management) and MiniMax’s English HKEX prospectus of 31 December 2025 (executive Directors), both direct from hkexnews.hk. Chinese reporting used where no primary text was retrieved: Jiemian 2025-11-12 (relaying Luo Fuli’s WeChat Moments post), National Business Daily 2025-12-17, Jiemian 2025-03-17 (relaying Lanjing News and an earlier 36Kr report with Baichuan’s reply), 36Kr 2026-07-24 (republishing a Bowang Caijing commentary; used only for dated departures and co-founder designations, not for its claims about motives), Jiemian 2025-05-09 (relaying 36Kr and 01.AI’s reply), The Paper 2026-01-26 (StepFun B+ round), Lanjing News 2025-12-31 (Moonshot internal letter). Web search was used only to discover addresses. WeChat Moments posts and internal letters cannot be retrieved; records relaying them say so. cninfo’s announcement index for Huichen (688500) was queried for June–October 2026 to check a reported appointment of Ru Liyun; no such filing was found. Note on the Zhipu prospectus: its text layer drops Chinese characters and interleaves table columns; round totals were read from rows labelled “Total” and checked by summing the listed considerations (B3’s listed rows sum to about RMB115 short of the stated total; the stated total is recorded). Chinese name forms of Zhipu and MiniMax personnel are not in the English text layer; 趙鵬宇 is taken from the Chinese MiniMax prospectus (2025123100026_c), whose text layer is otherwise mostly without CJK characters; Zhou Yucong’s Chinese name could not be read.
